name: Meraja
title: Priestly Head in the Time of Joiarib
summary: Meraja was a head of a priestly family in Jerusalem after the return from the Babylonian exile. He served as leader of the priestly line of Seraiah during the days of the high priest Jehoiakim. He is mentioned in the book of Nehemiah in connection with the registration of priestly family heads.

keyEvents.title: Registration as a Priestly Head
keyEvents.description: Meraja is mentioned as head of the priestly line of Seraiah during the days of the high priest Jehoiakim, son of Jeshua.

keyEvents.title: Priestly Service after the Exile
keyEvents.description: Meraja served as part of the rebuilt priestly service system in Jerusalem after the return from Babylon.

keyEvents.title: Connection to the Line of Seraiah
keyEvents.description: Meraja belonged to the priestly lineage of Seraiah, a prominent priestly family that had responsibility in the temple.

keyEvents.title: Service under the leadership of Jehoiakim
keyEvents.description: Under the high priest Jehoiakim's leadership, Meraja and other priestly heads served as leaders for their respective families in temple service.
